name: bounded_queue_pipeline
task: This project implements a three-stage producer / transform workers / collector pipeline with std::thread, split across multiple translation units: include/bounded_queue.h + src/bounded_queue.cpp (a thread-safe bounded FIFO queue of ints built on std::mutex and two std::condition_variable objects, with close() semantics), include/pipeline.h + src/pipeline.cpp (run_pipeline(), which wires a producer thread, N transform threads and a collector thread together with two queues, and a sequential reference), and src/main.cpp (the profiling entry point). BoundedQueue has two synchronization bugs. (1) pop() removes an item but never notifies not_full_, so a producer blocked in push() on a full queue sleeps forever and the pipeline deadlocks as soon as the input is larger than the queue capacity. (2) close() sets the closed flag but does not notify not_empty_ or not_full_, so consumers (and producers) that are already blocked never wake up to observe the flag, and run_pipeline() hangs at shutdown. The test harness runs every test with a 10 second watchdog and reports a hang as a failure. Fix src/bounded_queue.cpp so that push(), pop() and close() are free of lost wake-ups and deadlocks: pop() must return false only when the queue is closed and fully drained, a blocked push() must wake up when space becomes available or the queue is closed, and run_pipeline() must return the same sum as pipeline_reference() for every queue capacity and worker count. Keep the std::thread / mutex / condition_variable design. Do not change any function signature declared in include/bounded_queue.h or include/pipeline.h.
notes: build_command compiles the profiling entry point at build/app (src/main.cpp -> bounded_queue.cpp, pipeline.cpp). This binary must be built and then executed via run_command to drive DiscoPoP's instrumentation and produce its dynamic profiling output, including dynamic_dependencies, over the producer, worker and collector threads in run_pipeline(). test_command builds and runs a separate correctness harness at build/run_tests (from tests/test_main.cpp); it is independent of the profiling binary and should not be used as the DiscoPoP execution target. Both binaries link the same bounded_queue.cpp, pipeline.cpp object files, so no separate CMake/Meson/etc. configuration is required — plain 'make' is sufficient to build, run, and test. This task uses std::thread instead of OpenMP, so the build links with -pthread; DiscoPoP's instrumentation of multi-threaded std::thread code is limited and its dependency data mainly reflects the queue operations.
